declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement on behalf of Hargrove Lane LLP in support of preliminary approval. The parties reached the settlement through arm’s-length negotiations. Class relief and attorneys’ fees were discussed during the same negotiation; I do not represent that class relief was agreed before fees were discussed. The settlement provides a $29,250,000 class fund, distributed automatically to identified class members without a claims process. Brightline will separately pay up to $5,300,000 in fees and expenses, subject to court approval. There is no clear-sailing provision, and any fees the Court does not award will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. I have not disclosed confidential mediation offers or communications.
